commands: set -euo pipefail; IDF="$HOME/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4"; test -f "$IDF/export.sh"; . "$IDF/export.sh" >/dev/null; test "$IDF_PATH" = "$IDF"; VERSION=$(idf.py --version); printf '%s\n' "$VERSION"; case "$VERSION" in *v5.5.4*) ;; *) echo 'Unexpected ESP-IDF version' >&2; exit 7;; esac; printf 'ESP32-C6 ESP-IDF 5.5.4 toolchain ready\n'
